_comment: All dimensions in mm. Values marked ESTIMATE were read off photos - measure your part with calipers and replace them.
_disc: false = open bellmouth ring, one part, best airflow. true = disc valve look (disc + fins), uses the disc_*/post_*/fin_* values below
_flange_od: ESTIMATE - outer diameter of the visible ring
_flange_t: thickness of the flange plate (was 3; 6 gives room for a 6 mm inlet lip)
_flange_lip_depth: outer seal lip, measured from front face toward the wall (3 mm beyond the plate)
_flange_chamfer: front outer edge, 45 deg (also kills elephant foot)
_inlet_lip_r: AIRFLOW - rounded inlet on the bore edge (45 deg chamfer + arc). Max = flange_t; 0 = sharp edge
_collar_od: MEASURED 115 mm - ring that fits into the ceiling part
_collar_h: ESTIMATE - depth from flange front face to collar end (27 mm beyond the 6 mm plate, as the 30/3 original)
_disc_chamfer: front edge chamfer, only used when disc_edge_r = 0
_disc_edge_r: AIRFLOW - rounded front edge of the disc. Max = disc_t; 0 = chamfer
_disc_rim_h: stiffening rim on disc back (original has one)
_standoff: air gap between disc back and flange front plane. Throat is the annulus disc/bore; standoff only throttles air from straight ahead (see airflow.py)
_post_r: radius of the 3 posts/fins from centre
_fit_clearance: radial clearance pin/hole - raise to 0.3 if too tight
